person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person, with focalization moving among Casey, Jennifer, Emily, Daniel Greene, and other characters. Quotes q00050 and q00051 independently expose sustained third-person narration, while authorized excerpts show the same mode in early and separate passages; the whole-book source explicitly confirms that these focal shifts remain third person. The first-person q00043 passage and the other I/we/you examples are local speech or generic address, not autonomous first- or second-person narrative sections. No credible evidence of alternating grammatical person was found; the only minor uncertainty is the omitted speaker context for q00043, which does not affect the book-level result because its quotation boundaries mark it as speech.
